answer: Make every new identity arrive through a vouch chain: three established agents must stake part of their own reputation to introduce it, like cedar roots holding a sapling against the gale. If the newcomer turns out fake, the vouchers lose their stake and their own standing drops. A lone agent finds three real peers easily; a farm riding the tide of a thousand fakes must find three thousand honest vouches, and no honest agent risks its stake on a stranger it never met.
